I bought this stuff on a whim, having tried the original Mineral 89 serum and liking it. I didn't expect much, but after a couple of applications it was clear this serum would be my ticket - finally - out of perioral dermatitis land (which, turns out, is actually just h*ll). I'd tried everything: antibiotics, special creams and ointments, all the supposed PD remedies on social media, and obviously abstaining from all fun skin care and make up – for literally 3 years. I found products that didn't hurt (like the original Mineral 89) but nothing that helped. This stuff actually helps. I can put it directly on my affected skin, it feels soothing and hydrating. I go to bed with it on and in the morning my affected skin looks and feels stronger and healthier. I've been using it for about 3 weeks and am now at a point where I can put a little bit of make up on my trouble spots without the tiny pustules appearing. I should say: I haven't tried it on a flareup, as I havent had one in a while, so I can't speak to its ability to help with that. But as far as putting it on PD areas that are under control, and strengthening the skin barrier in those areas so that the PD can actually go away - 10/10 endorsement from me. If I could meet the Frenchies who created this serum I'd give them a blubbery tearful hug and they'd think I was a lunatic. But people with stubborn cases of PD get it. It's an awful, life-altering condition which is why I had to share this review. I'm hoping that a happy s
